The fee comes from alimm_share_info_dto, falling back to alimama_share_fee only when the dto field is absent; an invalid value does not fall back and gives null. Amounts keep their JSON literal and go through yuanStrToFen. Settled now means tk_status 3 (BR-FUND-02), not tk_earning_time.
